The main challenge is to define precisely the consequences of the design changes on the already published documentation and to understand the immediate impact on Customers operations, with the objective to provide customised documentation in accordance with aircraft configuration. Experience Level needed: 0 to 5 yrs The jobholder will be responsible of a portfolio of ATA chapters for all aircraft programs across Airframe /Systems / Cabin perimeters and will be responsible for the following activities: Writing of Technical Data Authoring activities of a Manual in accordance with specifications and quality standards, contractual commitments, configuration management rules, approved schedules, quality standards. Assessment of aircraft design inputs (Mod & Mod Proposal, Service Bulletin, …) that drive aircraft evolution in order to detect the impacts in the technical documentation. The jobholder could have to work in close cooperation with numerous interfaces: customer services departments, design offices, airlines, suppliers. title: Lead Data Analyst

The team is building towards an analytics capability that progresses from descriptive and diagnostic analytics to predictive and prescriptive insights, using statistical methods, applied data science, and GenAI where each approach is appropriate. Collaborate with senior stakeholders to understand priorities and roadmap, frame ambiguous problems, and turn technology data into analytical products, predictive capabilities, and AI-enabled solutions that achieve measurable outcomes. Demonstrated thought leadership in the application of data, analytics, data science, and AI to complex technology problems. Ability to work independently and with senior technology leaders to turn ambiguous problems into clear analytical questions, measurement frameworks, data solutions, models, and decision capabilities. Understand and articulate interfaces with Target Technology representatives, Product Managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to validate analytical requirements and present final results. Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail, accuracy, and sound analytical judgment. Consult, design, develop, and deliver analytical solutions and AI (GenAI, Agent, Agentic) resulting in decision support, predictive insights, risk models, or reusable analytical capabilities. Connect signals across software delivery, applications, infrastructure, incidents, reliability, security, ownership, dependencies, and other technology domains to discover patterns and drivers that are not visible through isolated metrics. Develop expertise in technology domain context and cultivate trusted relationships with technology and product leaders; be a strong storyteller using data to influence decisions. Contribute to and establish the right artifacts to document AI solutions, analytical methodologies, model assumptions, evaluation approaches, and responsible-use considerations used in analytical projects. Contribute to knowledge-sharing systems, mentor analysts, and raise analytical standards through reusable methods, reviews, learning forums, and iterative model-building practices. Ensure compliance with corporate data protection standards and establish responsible AI practices, including data privacy, bias mitigation, explainability, governance, and appropriate risk considerations for analytical and AI-driven solutions. Keep up to date on technology analytics, applied data science, GenAI, agentic AI, and emerging methodologies, and identify high-value opportunities to apply them across ITDP. About You Experience: Overall 8-12 years exp and relevant 6-8 years exp Qualification: B.Tech / B.E. or Masters in Statistics /Econometrics/Mathematics equivalent Adept at Structured Query Language (SQL), SQL optimization, data warehousing, and DW/BI concepts. Proficient in BI visualization tools (i.e. Looker, Power BI, Tableau) with ability to learn additional vendor and proprietary visualization tools. Expert in structured and unstructured data environments with proven hands-on work with large, complex datasets and multiple data sources. Hands-on experience in R, Python, or other open-source languages and analytical environments. Technical proficiency in analytical techniques such as Regression, Time-series models, Classification, Forecasting, Anomaly Detection, and similar methods to discover and measure key technology drivers and risks. Ability to evaluate statistical and machine-learning approaches, assess model performance and calibration, understand uncertainty and limitations, and translate models into actionable decision capabilities. Git source code management and experience working in an agile environment. Systematic and logical approach to problem-solving, with strong critical thinking and ability to navigate ambiguity and cross-domain dependencies. Highly self-motivated with a strong sense of urgency and ability to work independently and in team settings in a fast-paced environment; capability to manage urgent timelines. Ability and desire to teach, mentor, learn, and raise analytical capability across a broader team and stakeholder community. Excellent communication, service orientation, executive storytelling, and strong relationship-building skills; ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders. Identify and drive high-impact Generative AI (GenAI) opportunities by translating technology problems into scalable AI-enabled solutions that deliver measurable outcomes, including hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG, structured outputs, embeddings, or related techniques. title: Data Analyst
description: About the Company Founded in 2013 by Arpit Jain (CEO), PubScale (formerly greedygame) is a leading ad-tech company that drives app growth and monetization. We have built a sustainable, profitable business for over 7 years without chasing vanity metrics. Having completed our 0→1 journey, we are now scaling rapidly through our 1→10 phase. As a Google Publishing Partner, we serve 100M+ daily ad impressions and support 5,000+ apps and games worldwide, delivering up to 75% revenue uplift. We are trusted by brands such as Amazon, Dream11, MPL, ShareChat, Treebo and MobiKwik, and by 1,000+ publishers across 20+ countries. Our Products PubScale (our flagship product) PubScale brings monetization, user acquisition, revenue uplift and business-growth analytics together in one place. • Immersive Ads: Native, non-intrusive ad formats with smart caching, priority loading and adaptive refresh. They deliver a better user experience and higher monetization, without annoying pop-ups. • Offerwall: A reward-based engagement layer that monetizes non-paying users through personalized, high-conversion tasks, driving eCPMs of up to $1,000 in Tier geographies and up to 3x more revenue in emerging markets. • AdX & GROW : Monetization through Google Ad Manager and premium demand partners, plus GROW, an AI-driven user acquisition engine with free credits and optimization support. About the Role As a Data Analyst at GreedyGame, you will analyze mobile advertising, user behavior and monetization metrics to support app growth and revenue platforms such as PubScale. You will be the person teams turn to when they ask, “What is the data telling us?” You will work with Product, Ad Ops, Sales and Engineering to track revenue, understand what drives it, and catch problems early, from a drop in fill rate to a spike in suspicious traffic. What You'll Do • Write SQL to pull and combine ad, app and revenue data, using window functions, CTEs and date-based rollups. • Build and maintain dashboards for key metrics such as revenue, eCPM, fill rate, CTR, installs and cost per install. • Analyze trends by country, platform, app and demand partner, and explain why a number moved. • Clean and explore data in Python (pandas and NumPy): handle missing values and duplicates, aggregate data and spot outliers. • Design and analyze A/B tests on ad placements, formats and pricing, and give a clear go/no go recommendation backed by numbers. • Flag unusual traffic or sudden changes in key metrics, and work with Ad Ops to investigate them. • Turn findings into short write-ups and recommendations that non-technical teams can act on. • Improve data quality by defining metrics consistently and documenting where each number comes from. What We're Looking For • Experience: 2–5 years in a data analyst or similar analytics role. • SQL (strong): Joins, GROUP BY, CTEs, window functions (RANK, LAG, running totals) and date logic. You write queries that stay correct when data is missing or duplicated. • Python for analysis: pandas and NumPy for filtering, groupby, pivot tables, handling missing values and exploratory data analysis (EDA). • Statistics: Means vs. medians, distributions and outliers, confidence intervals, p-values and A/B testing fundamentals, including common pitfalls such as multiple testing and skewed data. • Dashboards: Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool, such as Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI or Metabase. • Problem solving: You break a vague question into clear steps and sanity-check your answer before sharing it. • Communication: You explain findings in plain language, with one clear chart and one clear recommendation. • Education: A degree in a quantitative field (engineering, statistics, mathematics, economics or computer science), or equivalent experience. Nice to Have • Experience in ad-tech, mobile apps, gaming or another high-volume digital business. • Familiarity with ad metrics and concepts: eCPM, fill rate, ARPDAU, mediation, programmatic auctions and invalid traffic. • Basic machine learning: regression and classification, train/test splits, overfitting and data leakage. • Experience with cloud data tools such as BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake or Spark. Why PubScale? • Your analysis directly shapes revenue decisions for app developers around the world. • Hybrid work model: 3 days in our Bengaluru office and 2 days remote. • High ownership, visibility and direct collaboration with leadership. • A fast-paced startup environment where your work has a significant impact on business growth. • Competitive compensation, performance rewards and learning opportunities. • A collaborative culture focused on innovation, speed and execution.
